main_topics.reason: The user opened by asking whether a different levothyroxine maker was a concern and returned several times to what the switch meant.
The user asked when to recheck TSH, whether a recent result counted, and confirmed the timing for a new test.
The user asked what changes to watch for and said they tend to notice coldness and tiredness quickly.
The user said they would prefer to stay on one brand to avoid uncertainty and discussed raising this with the pharmacy or doctor.
The user said they were annoyed that the pharmacy switched the product without explaining the change.
The user asked whether to keep taking the medicine exactly as before and accepted guidance to keep the routine consistent.

output.summary: The user asked whether a switch to a different maker of levothyroxine required action, and sought guidance on TSH testing, symptoms to watch for, and whether to keep the same routine. The assistant advised a new TSH test about 6–8 weeks after the switch and discussed asking for brand consistency; the user said the plan was clear and was exactly the kind of answer they wanted.
